WITHIN 20 BUSINESS DAYS OF THE APPROVAL OF THE AWC, ERICKSON WILL OFFER TO REIMBURSE THE CUSTOMER FOR ANY SURRENDER CHARGES SHE INCURS FOR LIQUIDATING THE VARIABLE ANNUITY (THE OFFER). THE OFFER WILL BE MADE IN WRITING AND SENT TO THE CUSTOMER'S LAST KNOWN ADDRESS. IF THE CUSTOMER ACCEPTS THE OFFER AND LIQUIDATES THE VARIABLE ANNUITY WITHIN 60 CALENDAR DAYS AFTER THE OFFER IS MADE, ERICKSON SHALL REIMBURSE THE CUSTOMER FOR ANY AND ALL SURRENDER CHARGES SHE INCURS FOR LIQUIDATING THE VARIABLE ANNUITY. IF THE CUSTOMER ACCEPTS THE OFFER, ERICKSON SHALL PROVIDE PROOF OF PAYMENT TO FINRA OF HIS REIMBURSEMENT TO THE CUSTOMER OF THE SURRENDER CHARGES SHE INCURS FOR LIQUIDATING THE VARIABLE ANNUITY. SUCH PROOF OF PAYMENT SHALL BE MADE WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS FROM THE TIME THAT REIMBURSEMENT IS MADE TO THE CUSTOMER. IF FOR ANY REASON ERICKSON CANNOT LOCATE THE CUSTOMER AFTER REASONABLE AND DOCUMENTED EFFORTS WITHIN THE TIME PERIOD FOR MAKING THE OFFER OR REIMBURSING THE CUSTOMER FOR ANY AND ALL SURRENDER CHARGES SHE INCURS FOR LIQUIDATION THE VARIABLE ANNUITY, ERICKSON SHALL FORWARD ANY UNDISTRIBUTED AMOUNTS DUE UNDER THE OFFER TO THE APPROPRIATE ESCHEAT, UNCLAIMED PROPERTY OR ABANDONED PROPERTY FUND FOR THE STATE IN WHICH THE CUSTOMER LAST RESIDED.
